profile.headline: iOS Developer | Versatile Full-Stack Mobile Engineer, Driving Performance, Architectural Excellence, and Measurable Product Impact
profile.summary:
Collaborate closely with product and design partners to translate business goals into intuitive, customer-centered mobile experiences delivered at scale. Own the full application lifecycle, from architecture and feature development through testing, deployment, and post-release support, ensuring accountability, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Champion reliability, usability, and continuous improvement by building production-ready software that solves real customer problems and strengthens overall product performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Agile Methodologies · Spring Boot · JSON · Database Administration · iOS · CocoaPods · API Development · Git · MySQL · React Native · Scrum · GitHub · Cassandra · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer III - iOS
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained the BoatUS mobile application using Swift and Objective-C, delivering 50+ feature enhancements, improving user engagement and overall application performance.
• Partnered with designers and stakeholders to refine UI/UX using Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD, incorporating user feedback, optimizing usability, and elevating customer satisfaction.
• Built and maintained APIs and backend services in C#/.NET and Node.js, ensuring seamless mobile functionality and reliable data exchange.
• Contributed across full SDLC, from requirements gathering through deployment and post-release support,  elevating system reliability while accelerating issue resolution in production environments.
• Investigated crashes and performance issues, implementing targeted fixes and enhancing app stability and overall reliability.
• Created onboarding documentation and mentored new team members, strengthening team productivity and accelerating ramp-up times.
• Managed Node.js services running on Google Cloud, supporting secure and responsive mobile interactions.
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · iOS · iPadOS · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Cocoa Touch · Objective-C · Crashlytics · C# · Agile Methodologies · iOS Design · .NET Framework · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · JSON · Swift Generics · UIKit · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Node.js · Lean Six Sigma · CocoaPods · Push Notifications · Xcode · API Development · Git · Scrum · MapKit · JavaScript · Firebase · XCTest · GitHub

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
• Creatively developed and designed apps using Objective C and Swift.
• Successfully released 4 apps to the iOS App Store.
• Maintained and updated apps by performing usability tests and other skills such as Debugging.
